raw_text:
description: When agents handle all processing, humans may lose meta-cognitive skills for knowledge work even while vault quality improves
topics: ["[[agent-cognition]]"]
source: TFT research corpus (00_inbox/heinrich/)

"To fully automate [metadata creation] is to outsource the very cognitive process that PKM seeks to enhance." Agent-run extraction, connection-finding, and synthesis can improve the vault while weakening the human's ability to structure ideas, recognize connections, and judge importance.

Mechanisms:
- **Collector's Fallacy, inverted:** Agents clear the inbox and organize the vault, concealing the gap between stored knowledge and human understanding.
- **Generation Effect bypass:** Generating ideas in one's own words supports elaborative encoding. Agent-generated connections benefit the vault without necessarily encoding them in the human's mind.
- **Extended Mind decoupling:** Offloading extends cognition only through an active human–tool loop. Without deep engagement, an excellent vault may become adjacent to, rather than part of, human thinking.

AI-native “vibe notetaking” normalizes effortless capture and automatic organization, accelerating delegation. The counterargument is that, in ars contexta, humans still direct and approve agent work. The open question is whether approval provides enough generative practice to preserve the skills behind good judgment.

This concerns **skill atrophy**, unlike [[does agent processing recover what fast capture loses]], which concerns memory for specific content. A warning sign is being unable to imagine doing the work without the agent. Possible mitigations include periodic manual processing and focused review of separate tend, prune, and fertilize operations instead of blanket approval.

Key connections: [[cognitive offloading is the architectural foundation for vault design]]; [[the generation effect requires active transformation not just storage]]; [[skills encode methodology so manual execution bypasses quality gates]]; [[you operate a system that takes notes]]. Related risks: [[productivity porn risk in meta-system building]], [[verbatim risk applies to agents too]], and [[PKM failure follows a predictable cycle]]. Like [[LLM attention degrades as context fills]], delegation may invisibly degrade capability; [[fresh context per task preserves quality better than chaining phases]] suggests an analogy for deliberate non-delegation. [[gardening cycle implements tend prune fertilize operations]] may support deeper review. [[maintenance targeting should prioritize mechanism and theory notes]] points toward skill-atropy and delegation mechanisms rather than MOC neighbors. [[vibe notetaking is the emerging industry consensus for AI-native self-organization]] describes the industry pressure behind this risk.
